url: Official Amaze File Manager repository documentation and F-Droid listing
note: Short hints that drive live exploration. Deliberately a 14-of-46 subset in different wording from ground_truth.json - if the two name sets matched, the run would be graded against the list that drove it.

features.name: Browse internal storage
actions: Tap on the hamburger icon to open the navigation drawer
Select 'Browse internal storage' from the navigation drawer
Tap on the 'Internal' option to proceed
Tap on the 'Storage' option to view the internal storage
Select the desired folder or file to browse

features.name: Copy files
features.description: Long-press the item(s) to select them
actions: Open the Amaze File Manager app
Navigate to the folder containing the files you want to copy
Long-press the item(s) to select them
Tap the copy icon in the contextual toolbar
Select the destination folder where you want to copy the files
Tap the 'Copy' option in the contextual menu
original_actions: Long-press the item(s) to select them
tap the copy icon in the contextual toolbar

features.name: Delete files
actions: Open the Amaze File Manager app
Navigate to the folder containing the files you want to delete
Long-press the item(s) you want to delete
Tap the delete (bin) icon
Confirm the deletion by tapping 'Delete'

features.name: Run a deep search
actions: Tap the search icon
Enter the query text
Press the search button

features.name: Show
actions: Tap the overflow menu
toggle "Show hidden files"

features.name: View file properties
actions: Long-press the file
Tap the overflow menu
Select 'Properties' from the overflow menu
Review the file properties in the dialog
Close the properties dialog

features.name: Extract an archive
features.description: Tap an archive file (ZIP, RAR, TAR, TAR.GZ, 7Z)
actions: Tap an archive file (ZIP, RAR, TAR, TAR.GZ, 7Z)
The archive viewer opens
Select the 'Extract' option from the menu
Choose the desired extraction location
Confirm the extraction process
original_actions: Tap an archive file (ZIP, RAR, TAR, TAR.GZ, 7Z)

features.name: Decrypt a file
actions: Tap the encrypted (.aze) file
Enter the password or authenticate with the fingerprint
Tap the 'Decrypt' button
Wait for the decryption process to complete
Verify the decrypted file by opening it
original_actions: enter the password or authenticate with the fingerprint

features.name: Edit
actions: Tap the drawer icon in the top left corner of the screen.
Long-press the bookmark to edit it.
Select the 'edit' option from the dropdown menu.
Enter the desired changes to the bookmark.
Tap the checkmark or save icon to confirm the changes.

features.name: Open the app manager
actions: Tap the navigation drawer icon to open the navigation drawer
Scroll to the 'Apps' section in the navigation drawer
Tap 'Apps' to open the app manager

features.name: Start the built-in FTP
actions: Open the navigation drawer
Tap on 'FTP' in the navigation drawer
Tap 'Start' to begin the built-in FTP

features.name: Connect over SFTP/SSH
actions: Open the drawer
Tap the '+' beside the network section
Select 'SCP/SFTP connection'
Enter the SFTP/SSH server address
Enter the username
Enter the password
original_actions: tap the "+" beside the network section

features.name: View recent files
actions: Open the navigation drawer
Tap 'Recent files' on the home screen
Select the desired file from the recent files list
original_actions: tap "Recent files"/the recent section on the home screen

features.name: Change the accent
actions: Open Settings
Scroll down to find 'Appearance'
Tap 'Appearance'
Tap 'Accent'
Select a new accent color
Tap 'Done'

readme_only.name: Leave any first-run analytics or settings screen
Tap Create Database or Open Database if shown
Enter a file name if asked and confirm Save
Reach the home or main screen
